symbols.name: TransportRecord
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass representing lossless envelope; has to_dict, from_dict, embedding_text methods.

symbols.name: TransportRecord.from_dict
symbols.note: Classmethod constructing TransportRecord from dict, coercing types and defaulting missing content/payload/metadata.

symbols.note: Returns stable text projection combining runtime/direction/event_type and content.

symbols.note: Converts AgentEvent to TransportRecord, validates direction, builds content per event type, generates record_id and timestamp.

claims.text: Lossless envelope exchanged between a runtime shell and downstream sinks.
claims.why: TransportRecord stores all fields without loss: original payload is preserved in `payload` and content is derived but original data remains.

claims.text: Embeddings are derived from this record; they never replace its original payload or provenance.
claims.why: embedding_text() returns a projection string; it does not modify the record or its payload. The original payload remains in `payload` and provenance fields (record_id, session_id, runtime, timestamp) are preserved.

claims.text: Stable text projection used by an optional embedding index.
claims.why: The method returns a deterministic string composed of runtime, direction, event_type, and content; no randomness or external state affects it.

claims.text: Wrap one typed event without discarding its provider-neutral payload.
claims.why: The function calls asdict(event) to capture all fields into payload and stores that payload in the TransportRecord, preserving all event data.

claims.text: direction must be input, output, or system
claims.why: The function checks `if direction not in {"input", "output", "system"}` and raises ValueError otherwise.

observations.what: No docstring promises beyond the ones verified; all claims in this chunk are kept.
